{{Top|Enemy|Grineer|Grineer|Weapon|Weapons|Weapons}} {{WeaponInfoboxAutomatic}} {{Codex|Creates and focuses a high-frequency field of microwaves, literally cooking the target from within.}} The '''Nukor''' is a {{Faction|Grineer}} sidearm that fires a microwave-like frequency beam that inflicts {{D|Radiation}} damage, boasting an extreme [[critical multiplier]] is heavily offset by its almost nonexistent [[critical chance]]. It also has a unique status effect called {{D|Microwave}} that enlarges enemy body parts. ==Characteristics== *This weapon deals {{D|Radiation}} damage. *Can inflict a unique status effect called {{D|Microwave}}, enlarging the body part that was shot at. *Damage ramps up from 30% to 100% over 0.6 seconds when firing. After firing stops for 0.8 seconds, the damage decays back to 30% over 2 seconds. {{Advantages|class=Pistol|trigger=Held| *Second highest [[critical multiplier]] of all weapons in the game, behind {{Weapon|Kuva Nukor}}. *Pinpoint [[accuracy]]. **{{M|Magnum Force}}'s accuracy penalty is minimal on this weapon. *Consumes 0.5 ammo per tick of damage. }} {{Disadvantages|class=Pistol|trigger=Held| *Limited range of 25 meters. *Pulsing weapon effect blocks the reticle, making it harder to make consistent headshots with the weapon shooting at moving targets. }} {{WeaponComparison|Kuva Nukor}} **Lower range (25m vs 29m) ==Acquisition== The Nukor's blueprint can be [[research]]ed from the [[Research/Chem Lab|Chem Lab]] in the [[dojo]]. {{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}} ==Notes== *Nukor can proc an invisible [[Status Effect]] called {{D|Microwave}} that causes the part of the enemy hit to become larger. **Microwave procs have infinite duration, but the visual effect does not. **Microwave counts as an individual status for {{M|Condition Overload}}, {{M|Galvanized Aptitude}}, {{M|Galvanized Savvy}}, and {{M|Galvanized Shot}}. **Some enemies are not affected by this [[Status Effect]], at least visually, for example [[Liches]] ==Tips== *There are several ways to make use of the Nukor's high critical damage by adding flat critical chance bonuses: **An [[Adarza Kavat]] with {{M|Cat's Eye}} can give your weapons an additive 60% boost to critical chance. **Likewise, [[Smeeta Kavat]]'s {{M|Charm}} can guarantee orange crits as one of its possible effects. **Using the [[Secondary Fire]] of the {{Weapon|Mutalist Quanta}} and afterwards firing the Nukor through the orb adds a flat +25% critical chance, in addition to +25% critical damage and extra {{D|Electricity}}. **{{WF|Harrow}}'s {{A|Covenant}} can add up to +50% additive crit chance, or +200% on headshots, after absorbing enough damage. **A fully ranked {{Arcane|Arcane Avenger}} has a 21% chance upon receiving damage to grant +45% flat critical chance. **{{Arcane|Secondary Enervate}} can gradually increase the Nukor's critical chance until a set number of [[Critical Hit#Crit Tiers|tier 2/orange/big]] critical hits. *With a maxed {{M|Primed Target Cracker}} and {{M|Hollow Point}}, the Nukor can achieve a critical damage multiplier of 10.8x, the highest critical damage multiplier value achievable outside of red crits. **It is however ill-advised to use Hollow Point if attempting a critical damage build due to the Nukor's extremely low [[critical chance]]. *The Nukor's short range, high accuracy and cone of fire means that {{M|Magnum Force}} can be used to provide additional damage without severe penalty. *The Nukor can be made into an effective anti-[[Sentient]] weapon by adding {{D|Cold|icon=Cold}} damage which, in combination with its innate {{D|Radiation}} damage, allows the Nukor to deal extra damage against Sentients while freezing them with Cold status effects. ==Trivia== [[File:Grineerheavyhugehead.jpg|thumb|142px|A [[Heavy Gunner]] trapped in {{WF|Vauban}}'s {{A|Bastille}}, with her head expanded by a Nukor.]] *This is the first known manufactured [[Grineer]] energy weapon and the second gun to deal pure radiation damage, the first being the {{Weapon|Detron}}. **The {{Weapon|Seer}} is ''technically'' the first Grineer energy weapon, as its projectiles appear to be energy; as well when reloading the magazine, an energy-like substance appears to discharge. Though there is the possibility that these projectiles could be superheated materials. **The Seer is also composed of Orokin technology, and not actually made by the Grineer entirely; this can bring to question whether or not the Grineer possessed the technology and/or know how to create an energy source or if it was simply salvaged from the Orokin tech. *As a microwave beam weapon, the ''Nukor'' could be considered a [[wikipedia:Maser|maser]] - such devices work similar to lasers, but using lower frequency microwave radiation. **The name itself is likely a nod to 'nuking', a term used to refer to cooking/reheating food or drink using a [[wikipedia:Microwave oven|microwave oven]]. *As the Nukor is being fired, its magazine will rotate and its front encasing will slowly open up. This can be assumed to be a method of cooling the weapon as it heats up during operation.  *The aimed body part of the target inflates in size as the target is damaged, as demonstrated by the picture above, identical to the effect of {{M|Peculiar Growth}}. This also works on bosses and other Warframes in PvP. *Enemies killed by the Nukor dissolve in a fashion similar to {{WF|Nova}}'s {{A|Molecular Prime}}, however this effect is purely visual and corpses can still be {{A|Desecrate}}d. **If said enemies had been killed by Nukor damage and sliced in half, the corpses will reappear. *Oddly, the Nukor has two separate energy colors when used with its default palette, being orange for the weapon energy colors themselves and blue for its radioactive beam and warped circles. **This however changes when the user is applying their own energy color and will apply the single color to both. *Previously, the Nukor's beam was treated as a source of AoE damage (such as an explosion) from point of contact of the Nukor's beam, allowing it to penetrate [[Shield Lancer]]'s shields (not to be confused with [[Punch Through]]). ==Media== NukorCodex.png|Nukor in Codex. BubbleHeadVor.png|The enlargement of body part also works on bosses. oh god.jpg|This is just getting silly now nukor_nova2.jpg|It also works on Warframes.   {{VideoGallery |{{YouTube|GAsn3kqJzws|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|0DjYAQOfah8|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|l5OR3v8naXM|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|AUBHEZD-50E|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|o66iaoTX6ZU|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|EpNkNrTGTLI|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|nl4aNfjpW9A|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|BoT1gPJVbI4|size=300px}} }} {{SkinGallery}} ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|38}} *Fixed script error caused by the Microwave Status Effect VFX. {{ver|35}} *Fixed weird behavior with the Nukor’s enlarging effect on enemy limbs. {{ver|32}} ;Ammo Changes We understand the power fantasy of these weapons is very popular for some, so our first approach was to keep them powerful, but limit how often they can be used by making changes to ammo pick-up. '''''Ammo Pickup Overrides'''''
The following weapons now have ammo pickup overrides, meaning they gain less from picking up ammo. This mostly applies to AoE weapons, in hopes that players will become more deliberate with their aim to make the most of their Ammo pools. The following lists the specific ammo pick up overrides per weapon category. '''Secondary Weapon Ammo Pick Up Overrides''' 20 Ammo per Pick Up: *Nukor {{ver|22.14}} *Fixed Beam weapons not being able to damage enemies (alive but in a ragdolled state) when being affected by certain 'crowd control' Abilities. *Damage now ramps up over 0.6 seconds and after moving off target there is a delay of 0.8 seconds before it starts to decay over 2 seconds. *All Beam weapons now start their Damage ramp up at 20% (instead of 10%). *The Multishot chance should now apply more consistently with Beam weapons. *Fixed Beam weapons continuously firing when quick Meleeing. *Nukor ammo capacity reduced to 60 in Conclave. {{ver|22.13.4}} *Increased the Beam weapon Damage ramp up time from 0.8 to 1 second. *Fixed Beam weapon Damage ramp up not happening per target. {{ver|22.13.3}} *Perfect accuracy and high fire rate is balanced by limited range and damage ramping up from 10% to 100% over 0.8 seconds when firing and decays back to 10% over 1 second after stopping. *Damage changed from 32 Radiation per sec to 22 Radiation per tick. *Fire Rate increased from 5 to 10. *Status chance increased from 20% per sec to 29% per tick of damage. *Critical chance increased from 1% to 3%. *Range increased from 20m to 25m. *Ammo consumption decreased from 1.0 to 0.5 per tick of damage. *Aimed Zoom reduced from 2.23x to 1.7x. {{ver|22}} *Fixed poor optimization on weapons like the Nukor. {{ver|21.0.7}} *Fixed the Nukor creating a ton of FX if it kills something while it's been paused by Harrow's Condemn ability. {{ver|20}} *Fixed a rare script error with the Nukor. {{ver|19.5}} *Nukor's magazine capacity reduced from 50 to 35 in the Conclave. {{ver|TIP}} *Nukor is now available for use in the Conclave! {{ver|17.1}} *Nightwatch skin added. {{ver|16.5.6}} *Fixed coloring on Nukor. {{ver|14.8}} *Fixed an issue where Orokin Shield Drones would rotate onto their sides when shot by the Nukor. {{ver|14.6}} *Tweaked the sound effects of the Nukor pistol. *Improved the performance of the Nukor on low end computers. {{ver|14.5.2}} *Fixed the magazine drop animation not playing properly on the Nukor. {{ver|14.5.0.2}} *Tweaked Nukor's sound effects. {{ver|14.5}} *Introduced. }}{{Ver/Lu|23.10.1}} ==See Also== *{{Weapon|Kuva Nukor}}, the [[Kuva Lich]] counterpart of this weapon. {{ResearchNav}} {{WeaponNav}} [[de:Nukor]] [[es:Nukor]] [[fr:Nukor]] [[Category:Weapons]] [[Category:Secondary Weapons]] [[Category:Single Sidearm]] [[Category:Grineer]] [[Category:Radiation Damage Weapons]] [[Category:Update 14]] [[Category:Continuous Weapons]] [[uk:Нюкор]]

== Stats ==

==Drop Locations==
{{DropLocations}}

==Notes==
*The mod's description is out of date; Nightwatch Napalm's blaze always deals a base of 150 {{D|Heat}} damage per tick. It ticks 6 times, once per second, with the first tick occurring immediately.
*Napalm damage can only be increased by base damage mods and arcanes (e.g. {{M|Serration}}, {{Arcane|Primary Merciless}}), faction damage bonuses (e.g. {{M|Bane of Grineer}}, {{A|Roar}}), and a Kuva Ogris' [[Valence bonus]] (of any element).
*Napalm ticks cannot deal [[Critical Hit|critical hits]] via any means.
*Napalm ticks each have a fixed 68% chance to proc {{D|Heat}} status, though this Heat status uniquely lasts for '''''only 3 seconds'''''.
**{{D|Heat}} status damage is affected by {{D|Heat}} mods.
**Chance for Napalm to proc Heat is '''not''' affected by mods.
**{{M|Continuous Misery}} and {{WF|Lavos}}'s duration passive increase the duration of the {{D|Heat}} status, but {{WF|Saryn}}'s passive does not add enough time to grant an additional tick.
*Because the size of the blaze is determined by the size of the rocket explosion, {{M|Firestorm}} ({{M|Primed Firestorm}}) increases the mod's effective area.
**While aiming with {{Arcane|Primary Compression}} installed will reduce the size of the rocket explosion, it ''does not'' reduce the size of the Napalm blaze (thought it also doesn't buff the blaze's damage).
*Each additional damage instance caused by [[Multishot]] will spawn an overlapping copy of the blaze.

==Tips==
*Given that [[Nullifier Crewman]] bubbles will deflect Ogris rockets, it is advisable to aim at a solid surface between the player and an approaching Nullifier, to allow the Napalm to spawn and the enemy to walk into it.
**Unlike {{Weapon|Zenistar}}, but similar to {{Weapon|Torid}}, Napalm will not damage a Nullifier's bubble or pass through it, but Nullifiers who walk directly into the blaze will be damaged, even while inside their bubble.
*This mod synergizes well with a {{D|Viral}} built Ogris, as the Heat status it causes reduces armor, further enhancing the Viral status' damage increase.
*Setting the Ogris' Energy color to black will virtually eliminate the visual effects of the blaze, which is quite large when using {{M|Firestorm}} ({{M|Primed Firestorm}}).
*{{A|Toxic Lash}} and {{A|Xata's Whisper}} trigger on each of the 6 Napalm ticks (dealing damage based on each tick's Heat damage), though [[Extra Hit]] mechanics which function by buffing your weapon's magazine (e.g. {{A|Resupply}}) do not.
**Elemental damage bonuses from mods and abilities will scale the damage of Extra Hits triggered by these ticks, even though they don't scale the damage of the Napalm ticks. 
**Combining bonuses to base damage, elemental damage, faction damage, status damage, and multishot can multiply Toxic Lash's damage from Napalm ticks to extraordinarily high levels, despite the low base damage of the ticks.

==Trivia==
*The Executioner mods (including Nightwatch Napalm) are the second set of mods to feature non-generic enemies on the mod card, the first being {{M|Vengeful Revenant}}.
*The mod used to disperse patches of fire across the ground, but was changed into a hovering ball of flames for unknown reasons. {{M|Napalm Grenades}} inherits the augment's original behavior.
*The fireball used to act as an obstacle that blocked projectiles, impeding direct hit follow-up attacks with rockets, and potentially causing the player to kill themselves by accident (back when the rockets did self-damage).
*The balls of fire ''used'' to damage [[Nullifier Crewman]] bubbles directly, but no longer do so. Their bubble now blocks the fire from hurting the Crewman inside unless they walk directly into the blaze.

==Bugs==
*Enemies that are ragdolled are not damaged by the flames. 
*While arcanes like {{Arcane|Primary Bulwark}} will scale the Napalm ticks, and in turn the [[Extra Hit|Extra Hits]] from {{A|Toxic Lash}} and {{A|Xata's Whisper}}, {{Arcane|Primary Compression}}'s damage bonus does not apply to either the Napalm ticks or the Extra Hits.

==Acquisition==

*Purchased from [[Ergo Glast]] during [[Operation: Ambulas Reborn]] for 75 Animo Beacons.

==Notes==
*Miter blades from both normal and charged attacks have a chance to instantly pop a Nullifier bubble.
*The augment actually destroys the floating shield generator that powers the Nullifier bubble, meaning the bubble is permanently disabled on the target enemy.
*Multiple blades resulting from [[Multishot]] will continue their flight paths as they collide with a Nullifier bubble, provided that one blade procs its chance to destroy the bubble, allowing the other blade to fly through. Otherwise, both blades will bounce off the bubble.
*Only affects the Nullifier shield bubbles of the [[Nullifier Crewman]], [[Corrupted Nullifier]], and [[Corpus Target]] when they spawn with a Nullifier generator, and has no effect on any other enemy in Warframe.
**Does not affect Nullifier bubbles created by [[Terra Shield Osprey]] and [[Isolator Bursa]].

==Notes==
*Overall damage will increase, though two parts of the damage still remain. As an example, an unmodified {{Weapon|Secura Penta}} equipped with nothing but Napalm Grenades will deal 325 {{D|Heat}} area of effect damage, as well as 325 {{D|Heat}} direct impact damage. If either procs, the enemy will be dealt procs equal to 162 {{D|Heat}} damage.
**In addition, direct impacts will create a separate 100 {{D|Heat}} which procs, likely there only to guarantee that enemies hit directly will be set on fire.
*'''Cannot''' be used with {{M|Tether Grenades}}.
*The fire patches generated by this mod last about 5 seconds.
*When installed, Penta's grenades are changed to detonate on contact while still maintaining the manual detonation function with [[Alternate Fire]] allowing mid-air detonation and possible headshots on humanoid targets, also resulting in fire patches spawning mid-air.
**{{M|Adhesive Blast}} can be installed to prevent grenades from detonating on contact by making them stick to the object that they make contact with in which they can be manually detonated or will auto-detonate about 5 seconds after attachment.
*Unlike similar weapons such as {{weapon|Torid}}, {{weapon|Pox}}, {{weapon|Mutalist Cernos}} and {{weapon|Ogris}} with {{M|Nightwatch Napalm}}, the fire patches generated by this mod do not deal direct damage, but instead proc {{D|Heat}} status effect when enemies enter the effect radius. This deals very little damage regardless of the mods on the weapon, but causes enemies to flail around. This effect works on the player as well. The Heat status effect is not affected by status duration mods.
*When used with {{WF|Mirage}}'s {{A|Hall of Mirrors}}, it will create extra patches of fire.
**The fire-patch of the user will cause {{D|Heat}} damage while the clone's fire-patches are only visual and will not damage anything.
*Unlike {{M|Nightwatch Napalm}}, the small fire patches range cannot be increased further, restricting the crowd control benefits of the bonus {{D|Heat}}. 
*When modded to create {{D|Gas}} or {{D|Radiation}}, direct hits and the patches will still deal {{D|Heat}} damage and status effects, though this is just for utility or crowd control as they will deal very low damage.

{{Quote|A weapon as old as those you hunt. Nataruk.

Nataruk can fire fast and true... But you will need to time your release with the weapon's rhythm if you hope to pierce the blighted skin of an [[Archon]].|[[Hunhow]]}}
'''Nataruk''' is [[Hunhow]]'s bow, forged from [[Sentient]] remains. It has infinite ammo, and releasing the shot just before a full charge will perform a "perfect shot" that is more effective.

==Characteristics==
*This weapon deals primarily {{D|Puncture}} damage.
*Releasing the shot after 70% of a full charge, indicated by white brackets and the reticle turning yellow, will perform a "Perfect Shot", with higher [[critical chance]] and [[critical multiplier]] over a fully Charged Shot.
**Both Charged and Perfect Shots feature a significantly larger projectile and [[Infinite Body Punch Through]].
*Four innate {{Pol|V}} polarities.
*Quick shots have a forced {{D|Impact}} proc.

{{Advantages|class=Bow|
*Infinite ammo.
}}
{{Disadvantages|class=Bow|
*Charged and Perfect Shots have a [[headshot]] multiplier of 1x.}}

==Acquisition==
Nataruk is given upon completion of [[The New War]], complete with a free weapon slot and a pre-installed [[Orokin Catalyst]].

Additional copies of Nataruk can be bought from [[Cephalon Simaris]] for {{sc|100,000}}.

==Notes==
*Charged and perfect shot arrows are coated with Void-like trails and "explode" on impact.
**However, despite the visuals, the weapon has no area of effect properties.
*The projectile hitbox of both the perfect shot and the charged shot is quite large, allowing the player to hit enemies and even achieve headshots without needing to be perfectly precise.
*Arrows do not arc while travelling.
**Arrows also have infinite travel distance, traveling in a straight line until they hit an obstacle or go out of bounds.
*Not [[Noise Level|Silent]], making it ill-suited for stealth. This can be remedied by equipping {{M|Hush}}.
*No [[headshot]] multiplier on charged or perfect shots. Quick shots will still benefit from headshots, however.

==Tips==
*Equipping mods that boost fire rate such as {{M|Speed Trigger}} or {{M|Vile Acceleration}} allows for faster charging and consequently more charged shots fired, but can make it harder to land the timing for a perfect shot.
**{{M|Critical Delay}} can be used over {{M|Point Strike}} to more finely adjust the fire rate to your personal liking and comfort.
**Be also mindful when in a squad with allied Warframes that have base or augmented abilities boosting fire rate (such as {{WF|Wisp}}), and the respective adjustment needed to still land perfect shots.
**Reload Speed modifiers such as {{M|Radiated Reload}}, {{Arcane|Primary Merciless}} and {{A|Speed}} can also directly speed up the time between shots, but without affecting the charge time.
*({{M|Primed Shred|Primed}}) {{M|Shred|Shred}} is an excellent mod that provides both Fire Rate (for faster charged shots) and Punch Through (to ignore small pieces of terrain and corners that shots might otherwise clip).
*The perfect shot's large hitbox and ease in achieving headshots benefits from headshot-focused mods and arcanes such as {{Arcane|Arcane Rage}}, {{Arcane|Primary Deadhead}} and {{Arcane|Longbow Sharpshot}}, as well as Warframe abilities like {{A|Covenant}}.
**When using ({{M|Galvanized Scope|Galvanized}}){{M|Argon Scope}}, you must continue to hold your zoom whilst the projectile is traveling to maintain the bonus. Consider pairing it with {{M|Terminal Velocity}}.
*Due to charged and perfect shot having large and long lasting visual effects, it is recommended to use darker energy colours to reduce screen noise.
*The size and intense glow of the Perfect Shot projectile can make it difficult to control if combined with {{WF|Ivara}}'s {{A|Navigator}}, so if both are going to be used together, darkening the energy color will be beneficial.
*{{WF|Nidus}} can make devastating use of this weapon in conjunction with {{M|Teeming Virulence}}; cluster enough enemies with {{A|Larva}} and use {{A|Virulence}} to trigger the augment's effects, then finish off any surviving targets caught in the mass.

== Known Bugs ==
* Despite listing 0.1s reload time (0.05s rounded up), the reload time is actually 0.6s.
* {{M|Galvanized Aptitude}} is multiplicative to base damage sources on direct hits from perfect and charged shots.

==Trivia==
*''[[wikipedia:Nataruk|Nataruk]]'' is an archeological excavation in Kenya where the remains of 27 people were found, all of whom have died 10,000 years prior to their discovery in 2012. The choice of name reflects how the bow was forged from Sentient remains by Hunhow, much like {{Weapon|War}} before it.
*With the inclusion of this bow, there is now at least one bow representing every major faction in WARFRAME; [[Tenno]] ({{Weapon|Paris}}, {{Weapon|Cernos}}, and {{Weapon|Daikyu}}, among others), [[Orokin]] ({{Weapon|Paris Prime}} and {{Weapon|Cernos Prime}}), [[Infested]] ({{Weapon|Mutalist Cernos}} and {{Weapon|Proboscis Cernos}}), [[Corpus]] ({{Weapon|Lenz}}), [[Grineer]] ({{Weapon|Kuva Bramma}}), and [[Sentient]] ({{Weapon|Nataruk}}).
*As indicated by its game files, Nataruk was originally called '''Omicrus'''.

==Acquisition==
*'''Necrophagic Vigor''' was originally obtained by reaching Rank 25 with [[Nightwave]] during [[Nightwave/Nora's Mix: Dreams of the Dead|Nora's Mix: Dreams of the Dead]].

==Notes==
*Requires a max health of 720 for the equipped [[Warframes|Warframe]], and a fully depleted magazine on reload to gain the maximum benefit.
*Health consumed is proportional to the percentage of the magazine being replenished.
**Having more than 720 max health will result in getting a larger benefit per amount reloaded, while having a larger magazine will result in a smaller benefit for the same flat amount of ammo reloaded.
*Health consumed upon reload is based off of maximum health, '''NOT''' current health.
**Having insufficient health to reload to maximum will result in a partial reload, or even the inability to reload at all if you don't have at least 20 health to lose.
**Reloading will reduce you to a minimum of 2 health.
*Bonus to Critical Chance and Critical Damage is additive with mods such as [[Point Strike]] and [[Vital Sense]].
